Name: Enri0425's Accessible Alex Heart Events
Author: Enri0425
Description:
This mod changes Alex's 2 and 8 heart events so that you can see them in more seasons other than Summer.
You need SMAPI and Content Patcher for this mod to work.
Now, to view the heart events, you need to meet the following requirements:
[list]
[*]2 heart event: Go to the beach on a sunny day in any season except Winter from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. ;
[*]8 heart event: Go to the beach on any weather in any season from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
[/list]This mod may be incompatible with others that alter Alex's heart events.
